rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a person employed to clean rooms, floors, or other places.

example.english: The cleaner cleaned all our windows today.
example.traditional: 清潔工今日幫我哋洗晒啲窗。
example.jyutping: cing1 git3 gung1 gam1 jat6 bong1 ngo5 dei6 sai2 saai3 di1 coeng1

rows.note: Use this for the common household cleaning machine, specifically a vacuum cleaner.

example.english: The vacuum cleaner is broken, so the whole house is dusty.
example.traditional: 吸塵機壞咗，成間屋都有塵。
example.jyutping: kap1 can4 gei1 waai6 zo2 seng4 gaan1 uk1 dou1 jau5 can4

rows.note: Use this for a chemical cleaning product used on objects or surfaces rather than the body.

example.english: This cleaner is great for removing grease.
example.traditional: 呢隻清潔劑去油污好掂。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 cing1 git3 zai1 heoi3 jau4 wu1 hou2 dim6

rows.note: Use this for a professional laundry business, including a shop where clothes are taken to be cleaned.

example.english: I’ll stop by the dry cleaner to pick up my clothes after work.
example.traditional: 我放工先去洗衣店攞衫。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fong3 gung1 sin1 heoi3 sai2 ji1 dim3 lo2 saam1
